en.title: Election: see how the 1st round result can affect IPCA+ Treasury and fixed-rate bonds
en.summary: The first round election results may impact the performance of IPCA+ Treasury bonds and fixed-rate securities.

stories.title: Brasil vence a Índia em ritmo de treino e com falhas do goleiro

en.title: Brazil beats India in training-like pace with goalkeeper mistakes
en.summary: Brazil defeated India 4-0 in Kolkata in a match played at a training-like level, with defensive errors from the opposing goalkeeper.

stories.title: Estêvão volta a marcar pela seleção em goleada com ritmo de treino no inédito duelo com a Índia

en.title: Estêvão scores again for the national team in training-like rout in unprecedented duel with India
en.summary: Estêvão scored for Brazil in their first-ever match against India, a lopsided victory played at a training-like intensity.

stories.title: TRE-MG está mandando mensagens por WhatsApp para informar sobre mudanças de local de votação

en.title: TRE-MG is sending WhatsApp messages to inform about polling place changes
en.summary: Minas Gerais electoral court sends WhatsApp messages to voters whose polling locations changed for the 2026 first round election.

stories.title: Eleições 2026: Acompanhe a cobertura da votação no Acre

en.title: Elections 2026: Follow voting coverage in Acre
en.summary: G1 provides real-time coverage of voting day, vote counting, and results from the 2026 elections in Acre.

stories.title: Lula diz que enfrenta ‘chefe de quadrilha’, e Flávio fala em vitória no 1º turno em últimos atos de campanha

en.title: Lula says he faces 'gang leader', and Flávio speaks of first-round victory in final campaign acts
en.summary: President Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro concluded their final campaign day for the 2026 first round with opposing messages, with Lula criticizing organized crime and Flávio claiming first-round victory.

stories.title: Mostra de SP terá ‘Sócrates’ de Walter Salles, doc sobre Musk e vencedor da Palma de Ouro

en.title: São Paulo exhibition features Walter Salles' 'Socrates', documentary about Musk and Palme d'Or winner
en.summary: An exhibition in São Paulo will showcase Walter Salles' film Socrates alongside a documentary about Musk and a Palme d'Or-winning work.

stories.title: Em último dia de campanha, Flávio Bolsonaro faz motocarreata ao lado de Tarcísio no interior de SP

en.title: On final campaign day, Flávio Bolsonaro holds motorcycle rally alongside Tarcísio in São Paulo interior
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro conducted a motorcycle rally in São Paulo's interior on the final campaign day for the 2026 first round, accompanied by governor Tarcísio de Freitas and other candidates.

stories.title: e-Título nas Eleições 2026: como baixar, atualizar e usar o aplicativo no dia da votação

en.title: e-Título in the 2026 Elections: how to download, update and use the app on voting day
en.summary: Brazil's electoral justice offers a digital voting title app for the 2026 elections. Voters can download and use the e-Título application on election day itself, though a physical document with photo remains an acceptable alternative.

stories.title: No último dia de campanha, Flávio Bolsonaro repete pai com motociata no interior de SP

en.title: On the last day of campaigning, Flávio Bolsonaro repeats father with motorcycle rally in São Paulo interior
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, organized a motorcycle rally on his final campaign day, following a similar strategy used by his father.

stories.title: Redes: Haddad é Lula em 80% dos posts; Tarcísio faz campanha solo e cita Flávio em 1%

en.title: Social networks: Haddad is Lula in 80% of posts; Tarcísio campaigns solo and mentions Flávio in 1%
en.summary: Analysis of social media posts shows Haddad references Lula in 80% of his content, while Tarcísio campaigns independently and mentions Flávio in only 1% of posts.

stories.title: Que horas começa e que horas termina a votação nas eleições 2026

en.title: What time does voting start and end in the 2026 elections
en.summary: Voting in the 2026 elections will take place from 8am to 5pm Brasília time.

stories.title: Na véspera da eleição, Flávio Bolsonaro e Tarcísio fazem motocarreata no interior de São Paulo

en.title: On the eve of the election, Flávio Bolsonaro and Tarcísio hold motorcycle rally in the interior of São Paulo
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro and São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas participated in a motorcycle rally in Santa Bárbara d'Oeste on the final day of campaigning before Sunday's election.

stories.title: TSE atesta sistemas de totalização de votos e emite zerésima da eleição presidencial

en.title: TSE certifies vote totalization systems and issues zero report for presidential election
en.summary: Brazil's Electoral Court certified the functionality of its voting systems and issued a zero report confirming no votes were pre-registered in the presidential election totalization system.

stories.title: Legacy monta ‘kit Brasil’ e aposta em eleição mais apertada do que as pesquisas sugerem

en.title: Legacy assembles 'Brazil kit' and bets on tighter election than polls suggest
en.summary: Investment firm Legacy Capital increased its directional bet on Brazil by distributing risk across interest rates, exchange rates, and stocks in anticipation of an election result closer than market surveys indicate.

stories.title: Forças Armadas apoiam logística das eleições em 482 municípios de 12 Estados

en.title: Armed Forces support election logistics in 482 municipalities across 12 states
en.summary: Brazil's Armed Forces will deploy 26,500 military personnel to support voting and vote counting operations in 482 municipalities across 12 states, with focus on security and access to remote locations.

stories.title: Rússia promete continuar ataques maciços a Kiev e pede que diplomatas deixem a cidade

en.title: Russia promises to continue massive attacks on Kyiv and asks diplomats to leave the city
en.summary: Russia announced it will continue targeted attacks on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities, requesting that foreign citizens and diplomats evacuate the capital.
